topics.note: Marking required, with 30-day written designation for unmarked information (playbook fallback).
topics.quote: designates as confidential in a written notice delivered within thirty (30) days after disclosure

topics.note: Oral disclosures protected only if summarised in writing within 30 days (playbook fallback).
topics.quote: only if the Disclosing Party summarizes it in a writing marked as confidential

topics.note: Prior knowledge must be shown by written records.
topics.quote: as shown by the Receiving Party's written records

topics.note: Independent development carries the 'without use of or reference to' qualifier.
topics.quote: without use of or reference to the Disclosing Party's Confidential Information

topics.note: Third-party exclusion requires rightful receipt without a duty of confidentiality.
topics.quote: rightfully received by the Receiving Party from a third party without a duty of confidentiality

topics.note: Only the four standard exclusions; all apply to both parties.
topics.quote: Confidential Information does not include information that:

topics.note: Use limited to the Purpose with at least reasonable care.
topics.quote: use Confidential Information solely for the Purpose

topics.note: Need-to-know Representatives, bound by equivalent obligations; each party responsible for its Representatives.
topics.quote: Each party is responsible for any breach of this Agreement by its Representatives.

topics.note: Prompt notice, cooperation at discloser's expense, disclosure limited to what is required.
topics.quote: give the Disclosing Party prompt written notice

topics.note: Reverse engineering of tangible materials prohibited.
topics.quote: will not reverse engineer, decompile, disassemble or analyze the composition

topics.note: Copies limited to the Purpose with notices kept; prompt breach notice.
topics.quote: will promptly notify the Disclosing Party of any unauthorized use or disclosure

topics.note: No use of information or derived data outside the Purpose.
topics.quote: or any data derived from it, for any purpose other than the Purpose

topics.note: No licence beyond the Purpose; information provided as is.
topics.quote: All Confidential Information is provided "as is"

topics.note: Return or destroy on request only: no deadline, no certification, no backup carve-out (fallback).
topics.quote: On the Disclosing Party's written request, the Receiving Party will return or destroy

topics.note: No residuals clause.
2-year disclosure period, 3 years' protection, trade secrets protected while they qualify.
topics.quote: continue for three (3) years after each disclosure

topics.note: No non-solicit or non-compete.
Irreparable harm acknowledged; either party may seek injunctive relief.
topics.quote: may seek injunctive relief in addition to any other remedy

topics.note: Government reporting preserved and DTSA immunity notice given.
topics.quote: Notice under 18 U.S.C. 1833(b)

topics.note: Trade-secret rights preserved; trade-secret obligations outlast the fixed term.
topics.quote: Nothing in this Agreement limits either party's rights or remedies under applicable trade secret law.

topics.note: Consent required, successor exception.
topics.quote: except to a successor to all or substantially all of the business

topics.note: Massachusetts law (Ninefold's home state), non-exclusive venue (playbook fallback).
topics.quote: governed by the laws of the State of Massachusetts

topics.note: Existence and terms of the discussions are confidential.
topics.quote: The existence and terms of this Agreement and of the parties' discussions are Confidential Information of both parties.

topics.note: Effective date, parties and signature blocks present; confirm legal names and signatory authority before signing.
topics.quote: (the "Effective Date")
